integrity: The corrected mathematical finding distinguishes newly checked zero-freeness and a complete-Pick obstruction from the exact axial kernel and boundary law already published. Finite checks are not independent priority certification.
scientific_limitations: New claims concern quantitative zero-freeness only on the canonical first-coordinate axis and failure of the complete Pick property for the full kernel. Previously published kernel, norm and boundary law are expressly attributed. Other measures/off-axis zeros are not assessed.
title: Quantitative axial nonvanishing and failure of complete-Pick interpolation in the canonical pentablock Hardy space
